entries.symbol: independent samples contributed by one investigation point to the characteristic value of a layer
entries.specRef: en1997-en1998-target.md G-02 / GI-13 give the sample set x_1..x_n without independence or a scale of fluctuation; W3 correctness review: the readings of one CPT are strongly autocorrelated, counting each as a sample drives k_n towards 0.1 and X_k towards the mean (unconservative)
entries.asWritten: One independent sample per investigation point and layer: the mean of the readings of one sounding inside the layer (spatial averaging over the layer thickness), with the Student t factor of n - 1 degrees of freedom for n = number of samples. A value k > 1 splits the readings of one sounding into k depth segments with the same reading count and averages each (scale-of-fluctuation reading). With fewer than 3 samples the cautious estimate is the lowest reading inside the layer. UNVERIFIED: the repo spec text states neither the independence rule nor a scale of fluctuation; compare with EN 1997-1 2.4.5.2 and EN 1997-2 Annex C of the print.

entries.evidence: Source Crawford and Kulak 1971 (Eccentrically loaded bolted connections, ASCE J. Struct. Div.) as tabulated in the AISC Steel Construction Manual, Part 7 (instantaneous centre of rotation); this is common practice for ductile bolt groups, EN 1999-1-1 8.5 gives no instantaneous-centre rule: R = R_ult (1 - e^(-10 Delta))^0.55; recalled, NOT checked against the printed standard (the repo holds no copy); verification is a human double-key.

entries.specRef: wave3c en1999
entries.asWritten: Load-deformation curve of one fastener R/R_ult = (1 - exp(-mu*Delta/Delta_max))^k with the deformation Delta proportional to the distance from the instantaneous centre: exponent factor mu = 10 /in * 0.34 in
entries.evidence: Source Crawford and Kulak 1971 (Eccentrically loaded bolted connections, ASCE J. Struct. Div.) as tabulated in the AISC Steel Construction Manual, Part 7 (instantaneous centre of rotation); this is common practice for ductile bolt groups, EN 1999-1-1 8.5 gives no instantaneous-centre rule: R = R_ult (1 - e^(-10 Delta))^0.55 with Delta_max = 0.34 in for the farthest fastener, hence mu = 3.4; the curve is for 3/4 in steel bolts and is applied to aluminium fastener groups by analogy; recalled, NOT checked against the printed standard (the repo holds no copy); verification is a human double-key.
